items.t: Burnham hails Brexit 'reset' at EU-UK summit
items.d: Leaders in Brussels agreed deals on youth mobility, food checks and linking carbon markets. The EU says the package hinges on settling university tuition fees within six months.

items.t: AI sell-off deepens as Anthropic slides again
items.d: Anthropic fell about 13% on its second trading day and the Nasdaq dropped 3.5%, now down over 12% in a month. Nvidia, gold and bitcoin also fell sharply.

items.t: Russian strikes kill eight in Kyiv, two in Lviv
items.d: Overnight missile and drone attacks hit nine Ukrainian regions, injuring 28, including a strike near Lviv's railway station.

items.t: Trump joins Ukraine talks, says Putin wants a deal
items.d: Trump sat in on Kushner and Witkoff's meeting with European leaders and Zelensky. Reports say US envoys floated NATO membership for Ukraine in exchange for ceded land.

items.t: Trump delays next Iran war move until new year
items.d: Trump told Axios he won't decide on further action against Iran before January, a day after Senate Republicans blocked a war powers bid 51-48.

items.t: World court rules Myanmar committed Rohingya genocide
items.d: The ICJ found 9-6 that Myanmar breached the Genocide Convention, a landmark ruling in the case brought by The Gambia.

items.t: Poland says Russian missiles and drone crossed border
items.d: Poland's army is investigating three objects, two missiles and a drone, that it says violated its airspace near Ukraine.

items.t: Wall Street split on whether AI boom has peaked
items.d: After Anthropic's record IPO, AI stocks are tumbling. Some analysts see a healthy correction; others warn of a bubble bursting.

items.t: California subpoenas Nvidia over chips reaching China
items.d: Attorney General Rob Bonta is probing whether Nvidia's AI chips were smuggled to China, adding to pressure after its CEO's exit.

items.t: US sells first deep-sea mining lease in Pacific
items.d: 31.5 million acres of seabed off American Samoa went for $6 million, opening a contested new front in mining for battery metals.

items.t: Apple building its own AI agent to run your Mac
items.d: A job listing shows Apple developing an agent that uses apps, browses and writes code, possibly by late 2027. macOS 27.3 will warn about giving rival agents full access.

items.t: EU Commission hit by AI-assisted cyberattack
items.d: Staff HR and health insurance systems were knocked out. The Commission says there is no sign of a wide data breach; the attacker is unknown.

items.t: Blue Origin to launch Google's space AI project
items.d: Google signed a New Glenn deal for Project Suncatcher, its plan for solar-powered AI computing in orbit, with first launch targeted for 2029.

items.t: UK admits offensive cyber ops against four rivals
items.d: A senior British general confirmed the UK runs offensive cyber operations against Russia, China, Iran and North Korea.

items.t: US lawmakers form bipartisan AI safety caucus
items.d: More than two dozen House members are launching an AI Safety and Innovation Caucus as Congress weighs rules for the technology.

items.t: How often you exercise matters more for mood
items.d: A study of 10,460 Norwegian students found frequent workouts were linked to less depression and anxiety a year later, more than intensity or duration.

items.t: Famous Taung Child fossil dated to 3 million years
items.d: Researchers say fossils grouped as Australopithecus africanus may be several species, complicating the story of human evolution.

items.t: Weight-loss jab halves knee pain for most patients
items.d: In trials of Lilly's retatrutide, top-dose users lost about 25% of body weight and two-thirds saw knee arthritis pain cut by half.

items.t: Youth visa scheme for 100,000 EU young people
items.d: The summit backed a scheme letting up to 100,000 young Europeans a year live and work in Britain, but Brussels wants a deal on tuition fees.

items.t: RAF Fairford case set for trial in late 2027
items.d: Two men charged over the September incident at the Gloucestershire air base will face trial in November next year.

items.t: UK expels Myanmar's defence attaché
items.d: After the ICJ genocide ruling, the Foreign Secretary ordered Myanmar's military attaché to leave Britain.

items.t: 賓咸稱歐英峰會為脫歐「重啟」
items.d: 雙方領袖在布魯塞爾就青年流動、食品檢查及碳市場掛鈎達成協議。歐盟表示，整套協議取決於英國能否在六個月內解決大學學費問題。

items.t: AI股拋售加劇　Anthropic再挫
items.d: Anthropic上市第二日跌約13%，納指跌3.5%，一個月累跌逾12%。Nvidia、黃金及比特幣亦大跌。

items.t: 俄軍空襲基輔八死　利沃夫兩死
items.d: 俄羅斯一夜間以導彈及無人機襲擊烏克蘭九個地區，28人受傷，利沃夫火車站附近亦遭擊中。

items.t: 特朗普加入烏克蘭會談　稱普京想達成協議
items.d: 特朗普參與庫什納及威科夫與歐洲領袖和澤連斯基的會議。有報道指美方提出以割讓領土換取烏克蘭加入北約。

items.t: 特朗普推遲至新年才決定對伊朗下一步
items.d: 特朗普對Axios表示，明年一月前不會就對伊朗進一步行動作決定；參議院共和黨人前一日以51對48否決戰爭權力動議。

items.t: 國際法院裁定緬甸對羅興亞人種族滅絕
items.d: 國際法院以9對6裁定緬甸違反《防止及懲治滅絕種族罪公約》，是甘比亞提告案的里程碑裁決。

items.t: 波蘭指俄導彈及無人機越境
items.d: 波蘭軍方正調查三件物體，包括兩枚導彈和一架無人機，指它們在烏克蘭邊境附近侵犯領空。

items.t: 華爾街分歧：AI熱潮是否見頂
items.d: Anthropic破紀錄上市後AI股急跌，部分分析員視為健康調整，亦有人警告泡沫爆破。

items.t: 加州傳召Nvidia　查晶片流入中國
items.d: 加州總檢察長邦塔調查Nvidia的AI晶片是否被走私到中國，令公司在行政總裁離任後壓力再增。

items.t: 美國首次出售太平洋深海採礦權
items.d: 美屬薩摩亞對開3,150萬英畝海床以600萬美元批出，為開採電池金屬開闢具爭議的新戰線。

items.t: Apple自家研發操控Mac的AI代理
items.d: 招聘廣告顯示Apple正開發可使用應用程式、上網及寫程式的AI代理，最快2027年底推出；macOS 27.3將警告用戶勿讓其他代理全面控制電腦。

items.t: 歐盟委員會遭AI輔助網絡攻擊
items.d: 員工人事及醫療保險系統一度癱瘓。委員會稱未見大規模資料外洩跡象，攻擊者身份未明。

items.t: 藍色起源將為Google發射太空AI項目
items.d: Google與藍色起源簽約，以New Glenn火箭發射Project Suncatcher太陽能軌道AI運算計劃，目標2029年首射。

items.t: 英國承認對四國進行進攻性網絡行動
items.d: 英軍一名高級將領證實，英國對俄羅斯、中國、伊朗及北韓進行進攻性網絡行動。

items.t: 美國兩黨議員成立AI安全小組
items.d: 二十多名眾議員組成「AI安全與創新小組」，國會正研究如何規管這項技術。

items.t: 運動次數比強度更有助心理健康
items.d: 一項涉及10,460名挪威學生的研究發現，經常運動與一年後抑鬱及焦慮較少相關，作用大於運動強度或時間。

items.t: 著名湯恩幼兒化石定年約300萬年
items.d: 研究人員指歸入非洲南方古猿的化石可能屬多個物種，令人類演化圖像更複雜。

items.t: 減肥針令多數患者膝痛減半
items.d: 禮來的瑞他魯肽試驗中，最高劑量組平均減重約25%，三分之二人的膝關節炎疼痛減少一半。

items.t: 青年簽證計劃涵蓋十萬名歐盟青年
items.d: 峰會支持每年最多十萬名歐洲青年在英國生活及工作，但布魯塞爾要求先就學費達成協議。

items.t: 費爾福德空軍基地案明年底受審
items.d: 兩名因九月格洛斯特郡皇家空軍基地事件被控的男子，將於明年十一月受審。

items.t: 英國驅逐緬甸國防武官
items.d: 國際法院作出種族滅絕裁決後，外相下令緬甸駐英軍事武官離境。
